title: Which BLACKPINK Member Is Your Perfect Match?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your BLACKPINK soulmate!

questions.text: How do you usually spend weekends?

options.text: Stay home watching movies, listening to music, or pursuing hobbies alone
Plan a detailed day schedule to maximize productivity
Explore new restaurants or events with a group of friends
Wake up naturally and decide activities based on the day’s mood

questions.text: When making an important decision, you tend to...

options.text: Analyze pros and cons to choose the most logical option
Imagine long-term possibilities and future impacts
Consider how it affects the people around you
Focus on concrete details and practical feasibility

questions.text: What kind of conversation do you enjoy most with friends?

options.text: Discuss abstract ideas or creative concepts
Share recent experiences and personal feelings
Solve a friend’s specific problem with practical advice
Reflect quietly before sharing your thoughts

questions.text: When starting a new task, you...

options.text: Adjust plans as you go, staying flexible
Prioritize logic and efficiency in execution
Create a detailed step-by-step plan first
Focus on the task’s emotional meaning and value
Completing a project with clear goals
Exploring new ideas or potential opportunities
Attending lively gatherings or group activities
Focusing on personal interests in a quiet space

questions.text: In team work, you excel at...

options.text: Proposing innovative ideas to push boundaries
Maintaining harmony and supporting team members
Analyzing problems and offering rational solutions
Ensuring accuracy by paying attention to details
Take a break to do something relaxing and unplanned
Talk to friends or do enjoyable activities together
Reflect alone to organize your thoughts
Tackle problems step-by-step according to a plan

questions.text: Your idea of a 'perfect day' is...

options.text: Helping others and feeling emotionally connected
Completing all planned tasks efficiently
Solving a complex problem or learning something new
Having unexpected adventures and spontaneous fun

questions.text: How do you prefer to gather information?

options.text: Through personal experiences and direct observation
By discussing with others and exchanging ideas
Through imagination and abstract thinking
By reading and reflecting alone

questions.text: What matters most when making choices?

options.text: Long-term potential and future growth
Concrete results and practical outcomes
Others’ feelings and shared values
Objective facts and logical reasoning

questions.text: How do you manage your time?

options.text: Keep a fixed schedule and plan ahead
Reserve time for socializing with others
Stay flexible to adapt to changes
Set aside alone time to recharge

questions.text: You see yourself as someone who...

options.text: Values emotional harmony in relationships
Focuses on the present and practical matters
Prioritizes logical analysis and fairness
Looks toward the future and possibilities

results.title: Jisoo’s Calm Companion
results.description: You and Jisoo share a grounded, thoughtful energy. Like her, you value stability and quiet moments, finding joy in life’s simple pleasures. You’re a good listener, offer practical support, and balance warmth with a calm presence—an ISFJ who thrives on making others feel cared for.

results.title: Jennie’s Bold Match
results.description: You and Jennie click with your confident, dynamic spirit. You both embrace spontaneity, have a sharp sense of presence, and aren’t afraid to take charge. Your quick wit and adaptability make you a natural pair—an ESTP who shines in the moment.

results.title: Rosé’s Artistic Soul
results.description: You and Rosé connect through creativity and emotional depth. Like her, you’re in tune with your feelings, find beauty in expression, and approach life with a dreamy, intuitive perspective. You’re an INFP who values authenticity and meaningful connections.

results.title: Lisa’s Energetic Partner
results.description: You and Lisa match with your vibrant, outgoing energy. You both love to explore, bring excitement to every moment, and thrive in social settings. Your enthusiasm and adaptability make you an ESFP—always ready for the next adventure.

results.title: Jisoo’s Logical Counterpart
results.description: You balance Jisoo’s warmth with a rational, strategic mind. Like her, you value reliability, but you add a logical edge—analyzing situations calmly and offering practical solutions. You’re an ISTJ who appreciates structure and consistency.

results.title: Jennie’s Strategic Ally
results.description: You and Jennie share a sharp, forward-thinking approach. You both excel at planning and executing ideas with confidence, turning visions into reality. Your strategic mindset and charisma make you an ENTJ—natural leaders who inspire others.

results.title: Rosé’s Intuitive Confidant
results.description: You and Rosé bond over deep intuition and abstract thinking. Like her, you see beyond the surface, exploring ideas and possibilities with curiosity. You’re an INFJ who understands others deeply and seeks meaningful purpose.

results.title: Lisa’s Playful Collaborator
results.description: You and Lisa thrive on fun and flexibility. You both hate routine, love to experiment, and turn even simple tasks into adventures. Your easygoing nature and creativity make you an ENFP—always seeing the bright side.

results.title: Jisoo’s Detail-Oriented Match
results.description: You and Jisoo share a love for precision and care. Like her, you notice the little things, ensuring everything is done right, and take pride in reliability. You’re an ISTP who combines practicality with a calm, hands-on approach.

results.title: Jennie’s Innovative Equal
results.description: You and Jennie are a dynamic duo of innovation. You both challenge the status quo, think outside the box, and turn ideas into action. Your quick thinking and adaptability make you an ENTP—witty, resourceful, and always one step ahead.

results.title: Rosé’s Sensitive Companion
results.description: You and Rosé connect through emotional sensitivity and empathy. Like her, you feel deeply, value harmony, and support others unconditionally. You’re an ISFP who expresses care through actions and finds beauty in everyday moments.

results.title: Lisa’s Social Spark
results.description: You and Lisa light up any room with your energy. You both love connecting with people, thrive in group settings, and bring positivity wherever you go. Your outgoing nature makes you an ESFJ—dedicated to making others feel included.

results.title: Jisoo’s Thoughtful Strategist
results.description: You and Jisoo balance thoughtfulness with strategy. Like her, you plan carefully, consider all angles, and value wisdom. You’re an INTJ who combines vision with practicality, turning long-term goals into reality.

results.title: Jennie’s Calm Realist
results.description: You ground Jennie’s boldness with a steady, realistic perspective. Like her, you’re confident but pragmatic, focusing on what works and staying composed under pressure. You’re an ESTJ who values order and efficiency.

results.title: Rosé’s Imaginative Partner
results.description: You and Rosé share a love for imagination and possibility. Like her, you dream big, explore creative ideas, and see the world through a hopeful lens. You’re an INTP who enjoys intellectual exploration and innovative thinking.

results.title: Lisa’s Adaptable Friend
results.description: You and Lisa thrive on flexibility and change. You both go with the flow, embrace new experiences, and make every moment engaging. Your easy adaptability makes you an ENFJ—warm, charismatic, and always ready to connect.
